nodes.label: KINETIX OS Web Prototype
nodes.description: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite 6 + Tailwind CSS v4 web prototype serving as visual reference for PySide6 desktop redesign. Components: Login, OperatorDashboard, SafetyConfig, SystemStatus, AlarmHandling, TemplateManagement, SystemLogs. All data hardcoded, no real MODBUS connection.
